quest.title: Leaves on the Wind
quest.description: Edith wants to write a new book about Anemo, but she's looking for some inspiration...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need, specifically?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: You can see the elements, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: I reckon that you just need to follow the trail of Anemo and search that way.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: I'll be waiting for you under the tree. If you find anything, just bring it down to me.

talks.objective: Search in the tree for 3 traces of the wind

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: I have to say that someone like you is definitely better suited to doing research.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: You have a great deal of adventuring experience, and great stamina...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: And most importantly, you can control the elements even without the use of a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: The elements... Is there really any research on this continent that could uncover their secrets? To a researcher, the ability to use a Vision or the lack thereof really is...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Ah, I went off on a tangent again... Sorry, please don't take it to heart.

talks.objective: Search in the tree for 3 traces of the wind

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Have you found anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got a few leaves here.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: ...Leaves? Let me have a look, please. Huh, you even put them inside a box...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: When held in your hand, these leaves do indeed allow you to feel the Anemo within them.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: To think that this tree really had this power. If I only had a Vision, then I wouldn't have had to waste this much time.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Thank you. This is a very precious resource, and I will use it as such.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Still, I don't have any method of preserving these leaves. It is fully possible that the Anemo in them could dissipate all too quickly...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Still, take this as recompense for your efforts. Who knows, I might need to call on you in the future to help me collect research material.

talks.objective: Search in the tree for 3 traces of the wind

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll do it.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Great, I'm counting on you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: What a shame, I can't use this material either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you working on?

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: I mean to write a new book about Mondstadt's history that focuses on Anemo, and I'm looking for inspiration here.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: If you think about it, this place is the ideal spot — there's a Statue of The Seven that represents Anemo, and a tree that's closely linked to the legend of the great hero Vennessa.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Yet — and I know this might sound funny — looking for and gathering Anemo without a Vision, which I lack, is too difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: And this so-called search for inspiration? Why, I'm just staring into space here. Most of my material is synthesized from second-hand resources as well.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: That's the life of a person without a Vision on this continent — to do much, and yet achieve little.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: One cannot use the power of the elements without a Vision. Whether in research or in life, those without them live like outsiders in their own world.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Hahaha, maybe in the eyes of the gods, Vision wielders are the main characters of this world.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Sorry, I said too much, and while I did say all this, I won't give up on my research.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: I don't have a Vision, but I won't lose in terms of scholarship.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: I've also heard that you can use the elements even without a Vision...

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: If you could help me to grab some objects imbued with Anemo, that would really help me with my research.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Could you help me climb up this tree and have a look?
